resources.string: CrackMyDroid reads the installed-app inventory locally to show APKs, activities, components, and permissions. No system dialog is shown: package visibility is declared in the manifest. An APK is exported or shared only when you start that action.
This installation does not have full app visibility. To avoid partial results, the scan is not started. Reinstall an APK that declares QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES in its manifest.
